articles.headline: Luka scores 42 points, earns high praise from Giannis as hot streak continues
articles.description: Luka Doncic's volcanic scoring spree continued Monday with 42 points in the Lakers' 138-117 win over the Heat, prompting Giannis Antetokounmpo to call him "one of the best scorers to play this game."

images.name: Luka Doncic #77 of the Los Angeles Lakers plays defense on Giannis Antetokounmpo [600x400]
images.caption: "Obviously, he’s one of the best scorers to play this game, if not the best," Giannis Antetokounmpo said of Luka Doncic, before adding the context, "Not right now. Of all time. I feel like some people are scared to say that, but he’s got to be up there.”
